relations.description: Procedure involves sending MODIFY EPS BEARER CONTEXT REJECT message.
Message contains EPS bearer identity IE.
ESM cause value #41 indicates semantic error in TFT operation.
ESM cause value #42 indicates syntactical error in TFT operation.
ESM cause value #44 indicates semantic error in packet filter.
ESM cause value #45 indicates syntactical error in packet filter.
Procedure occurs when MME is in BEARER CONTEXT MODIFY PENDING state.
Receipt of REJECT message stops timer T3486.
Receipt of REJECT message causes transition to BEARER CONTEXT ACTIVE state.
